note: The OLG adequately covers wage/salary types (Types of Earned Income page), BEACON data entry procedures (Entering, Changing, and Ending Earned Income in BEACON), and verification requirements at reporting periods — including extensive IR procedures for Work Number matching, cold calls, and VC-1 issuance when income changes or is inconsistent. The Recertification Interview page instructs workers to ask open-ended questions like 'What sources of income do you have?' which partially addresses FNS's questioning mandate. However, the OLG does not address the FNS requirement to investigate when household expenses exceed reported income. This concept appears only narrowly in the Dependent Care Expenses page ('if all expenses exceed income, request additional verification') but is not stated as a general investigative duty applicable to all income verification. The OLG's Unclear Information page covers follow-up on conflicting information during case maintenance, but this is reactive (triggered by received documents) rather than the proactive investigative standard FNS requires at certification.
